title: [v0.31.0rc][Attention][BugFix] Preserve GLM-Next shared-pool KV budget
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Release counterpart of #19457, targeting `releases/v0.31.0rc`. The main PR is still open; both branches need this fix.

GLM-5.3-Flash MRV1 applies an unnecessary per-layer KV budget discount after KPool attention is classified as SFA. The GLM-Next planner already accounts for physical sharing, so the discount can leave insufficient capacity for the configured 1M context.

Add `glm5_next` to the existing DeepSeek V4/V4.1 physical shared-pool exemption. Preserve the release branch's V2 full/sliding-attention sharing logic and all pre-existing tests. No deployment configuration is changed.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. GLM-Next retains its complete physical shared-pool KV budget, addressing the MRV1 startup capacity failure without reducing the configured context length.

### How was this patch tested?

- Release base: `2bd3b7fcd044c51b78e5943ac64dd8208e56b543`.
- Ran the release worker and test sources in the reproduced nightly image, using CPU-only containers without NPU devices. The unmodified release worker reproduces **2 failed, 2 passed** across BF16/C8 and sparse-on/off regression cases; the fixed worker passes **13 related tests**.
- Regression checks cover the exact physical KV budget for a 1,048,576-token context, planner capacity, and physical allocation sizes. Existing generic and DeepSeek budget tests also pass.
- Ruff check/format check, source compilation, and `git diff --check` pass. The changed lines match #19457 exactly.
- `bash format.sh ci` cannot start locally because `pre-commit` is unavailable. Full hooks and release NPU/nightly startup, PD requests, accuracy, and performance validation remain for CI/review before merge.

### Checklist

- [x] Focused port of #19457; existing release logic and tests preserved.
- [x] Release baseline reproduces the regression; 13 related tests pass with the fix.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/a98247ab4db686ee03c66d5feb3c761e52a2f8ab
